resources.string: Your vault is encrypted on-device before anything ever leaves your phone. We never see your passwords.
Nova Vault integrates with Android\'s autofill system to securely fill credentials in any app or browser.
Unlock your vault instantly with fingerprint or face authentication, backed by hardware-protected keys.
Please enter a valid email address.
Password must be at least 8 characters.

Your Master Password is known only to you. It cannot be recovered by Nova Vault or anyone else. Losing it means permanent loss of your vault unless you have a Recovery Kit.
Save your Recovery Kit somewhere safe and offline. It is the only way to regain access to your vault if you forget your Master Password. Nova Vault has no backdoor.
